---
name: Skill request
about: Propose a new skill
labels: skill-request
---

## What problem does the new skill solve?

Describe the agent-facing scenario. Example: "When a user asks to add Netdata monitoring to a Helm chart, no existing skill fires."

## Proposed skill name

`kebab-case-name`

## Proposed description (trigger text)

Start with "Use when..." and list the situations the skill should fire on. Keep under 300 characters if possible.

## Proposed scope

Bullet list of what the skill will cover and what it will not.

## Source material

Links to Netdata docs, playbooks, GitHub issues, upstream OTel docs, etc. that the skill content would draw from.
